paragraphs.text: Marvel Super Heroes (stylized Magic: The Gathering® | Marvel Super Heroes ) is the 112th Magic: The Gathering expansion . It is part of the Universes Beyond series, and was released on June 26, 2026. The design of the set is based on the original Marvel comics , and notably not on the Marvel Cinematic Universe .

Marvel Super Heroes is the second major release after Marvel's Spider-Man in a series of products created for Magic: The Gathering by Hasbro ( Wizards of the Coast ) in collaboration with Marvel Entertainment . The set features many Marvel Comics heroes and villains. The Avengers feature prominently, but not exclusively; other heroes include the Fantastic Four , S.H.I.E.L.D. , Heroes for Hire , and several "Avenger-adjacent" characters. The X-Men as a team are not present in the set, but individual characters with associations to the Avengers have been included.
Marvel Super Heroes is the biggest Magic set ever made, with more than 600 new cards, four Commander decks, and a product lineup designed to reach every type of customer.

The main Standard -legal set uses the code MSH and features 296 regular cards (91 commons, 100 uncommons, 60 rares, 25 mythic rares, 20 basic lands) . Alternate card frames have a different card number than the original version.

Marvel Super Heroes features Marvel Source Material cards. These may be found in Play Boosters and may be played in Limited games.

Marvel Super Heroes is sold in Play Boosters , Collector Boosters , and four Commander decks that also come in a Collector's Edition . In addition, there are the Marvel Super Heroes Bundle, a Gift Bundle , a Draft Night Box, two Scene Boxes , a Beginner Box and Jumpstart Boosters .
Four preconstructed Commander decks were released alongside the main set.
Marvel Super Heroes featured five Welcome Decks .

The set features six sets of scene cards with the MSH expansion code, which are available as part of the set's Booster Fun . Two separately sold Scene Boxes ( Heroes United and Villains Unleashed ) include three Play Boosters, six art cards , and a display easel.

Marvel Super Heroes Jumpstart is a supplemental Jumpstart set. Each Jumpstart Booster is a 20-card half-deck containing one of 51 randomly chosen themes. Any two half-decks can be combined to form a playable 40-card deck.

In addition to the June 26 release, this set features a holiday release slated for a December 4, 2026 release. This is a Spider-Man Commander deck .
Marvel Super Heroes was released digitally on Magic: The Gathering Arena and Magic Online . Unlike the previous Marvel set , it didn't receive a Through the Omenpaths treatment.

The set introduces the Power-up mechanic. Power-up is a keyword ability that comes attached to activated abilities , and represents characters using their full power. Power-up abilities are the same as exhaust abilities, in that they can only be activated once; however, they have a unique mechanic of being discounted by the mana cost of the permanent they belong to (including color) if that permanent entered this turn, making them akin to a kicker cost that can also be paid later for a greater price. Taking design cues from the usage of exhaust, many power-up abilities use counters to help players remember that they've already been activated.

Marvel Super Heroes also introduces the Teamwork mechanic. Teamwork is another variant on kicker that appears on noncreature spells. To pay a teamwork X cost, you tap creatures you control with X or more power.

Like in Marvel's Spider-Man , the Connive mechanic represents the schemes of villainous characters. When a creature connives, its controller draws a card, discards a card, then puts a +1/+1 counter on that creature if the discarded card was a nonland card. Heal is introduced as a new keyword action to remove damage marked on a permanent.

Another returning mechanic from Spider-Man is transforming modal double-faced cards . These cards represent a civilian identity on their front face, and a costumed hero on their back face. They can be cast as either face, but the front face has an expensive activated ability that transforms the card into the back face.
Cameos in the main set include boast , enrage , extort , improvise , and sneak .
The use of the Hero and Villain types is one of the major throughlines in the Marvel collaboration. This set has a focus on Hero and Villain typal .

The set introduces the Eternal , Gamma , Inhuman , Kree , Shi'ar , and Skrull creature types. The Spy creature type is used outside of an Un-set for the first time. It also introduces the Plan enchantment type. Plans work similarly to how previous sets have used enchantments with quest counters (i.e., they have triggered abilities that place counters on them, and gain an additional effect when they reach a certain number of counters), except that they use plan counters instead. Strangely, the set reuses the Arcane spell type for the first time in over 20 years, on a single instant and a single sorcery; it has no mechanical relevance in the set.
The card Mjölnir, Hammer of Thor is the only one to use the batching term " Worthy ". A creature is worthy if it's legendary , white and/or red , and not a Villain.

The set also introduces the predefined Vibranium token. Vibranium represents artifacts with indestructible and " : Add . This mana can't be spent to cast a nonartifact spell." The second ability is shared with Powerstone tokens.

Marvel Super Heroes contains a higher ratio of legendary creatures than any previous set, and is an outlier even among Universes Beyond sets. Every uncommon , rare , and mythic rare creature in the set is legendary. The Beginner Box also contains common Legendaries.
The set introduces plan counters as a sub-theme tied to Plans . It also introduces invasion and saurian counters . Poison and shield counters are used as cameos on only a single card each.

Hawkeye's Bow formed half of an instant-kill combo with Seeker of Skybreak in Pauper , which was so powerful that the latter was banned there less than a week after Marvel Super Heroes released.

The Fantasticar became a very powerful finisher in Vintage and Legacy artifact decks immediately upon its release, thanks to its broken synergy with the free spells and powerful artifact synergies omnipresent in these formats. Since fulfilling the condition for the Fantasticar's third ability is trivial in these decks, it was essentially a flying 16/16 with haste for . Its interaction with Moxen in Vintage would get it restricted in August 2026, and despite a lower volume of free spells in Legacy it was banned there as well.
Killmonger, Ruthless Usurper received Day Zero errata for his second ability to say "at end of turn ".
The French Geyser calciné ( Scorched Geyser ) was mistakenly replaced by both "Geyser brûlé" and "Geyser fumant" in the same set.
White Widow, Free Agent was erroneously attributed to the artist Smirtouille instead of to Julia Vasilyeva.
